description: This file contains utility templates and functions for handling OpenGL/GLES entry points in the ANGLE project, including default return values for various entry points and context identification functions.

classes.name: DefaultReturnValue<EP, ReturnType>
classes.description: Template struct for determining default return values for different entry points and return types.

methods.name: GetDefaultReturnValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for a given entry point and return type.

methods.name: CID
methods.description: Returns the context ID from a given Context object or EGLContext.

methods.name: CID
methods.description: Returns the display and context ID, with validation, for EGL display and context.
